startUrls.title: Hotel URLs
startUrls.description: Agoda hotel pages, e.g. https://www.agoda.com/marina-bay-sands/hotel/singapore-sg.html. Any language version and any search parameters work.

hotelIds.title: Hotel IDs
hotelIds.description: Numeric Agoda hotel ids (the hotel_id in Agoda links), as an alternative to URLs.

includeReviews.title: Include reviews
includeReviews.description: Collect guest reviews of each hotel. Turn off to get only hotel details.

maxReviewsPerHotel.title: Max reviews per hotel
maxReviewsPerHotel.description: Maximum number of reviews to save for each hotel. 0 means all reviews Agoda returns.

reviewsSince.title: Reviews since
reviewsSince.description: Save only reviews written on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Useful for scheduled monitoring runs.

providers.title: Review sources
providers.description: Which reviews to save. Agoda shows its own guest reviews and reviews from Booking.com on the same hotel page.

sort.title: Sort reviews by
sort.description: Order in which Agoda returns reviews. With a review limit, this decides which reviews you get.

includeReviewerName.title: Include reviewer first name
includeReviewerName.description: Add the first name the reviewer shows on Agoda. This is personal data, keep it off unless you need it.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy servers to use. Agoda usually works without a proxy.
